question: 45 years ago today, Montreal's best shot ended on "Blue Monday." In 36 seasons in Montreal (1969-2004), how many postseason series did the Expos win?
answer_detail: Their lone playoff trip came in strike-split 1981, when they beat the Phillies 3-2. Then on Oct. 19, 1981, Rick Monday homered off ace Steve Rogers, pitching in relief, with two outs in the 9th to send the Dodgers to the World Series.
